title: IBM 3270 P0 current state
summary: The current P0 line is candidate16: native IBM 3270/TN3270 first, honest basic TN3270E, one-writer ownership, evidence-backed MVS/TK5 states, and an s3270 differential adapter that now checks complete-response status, exact row geometry, field extended attributes and character-attribute state.
invariants: Traditional TN3270 remains first-class; TN3270E is used only for functions genuinely negotiated and implemented.
READ BUFFER, READ MODIFIED and READ MODIFIED ALL preserve native 3270 field/MDT semantics rather than flattening the presentation space.
SFE, SA and MF attributes remain in the model and READ BUFFER reconstruction; NONDISPLAY values are masked in detached snapshots.
Write Structured Field and Query Reply advertise only capabilities actually implemented.
Once TN3270LiveSession is claimed by TerminalSessionOwner, direct mutation fails closed and one-writer control passes through TerminalControlGate.
TSO READY requires a complete trimmed row exactly equal to READY; loose READY substrings are not authentication evidence.
The TK5 ISPF Primary Option Menu requires corroborating title, Option prompt and END instruction markers; recognition grants no PF/AID authority.
Terminal meter facts use the configured protocol source; TN3270 evidence must never be emitted as TN5250.
s3270 is an independent reference oracle, never Terminal Machine authority; differential comparison is presentation-space semantics rather than screenshot equality.
The s3270 adapter masks NONDISPLAY data and fails closed on unsupported DBCS/multi-byte cell tokens rather than manufacturing equality.
Downstream MVS Intention may consume Terminal Machine observations but does not acquire terminal mutation authority or MVS/JES semantic authority.
AID send completion is not host semantic completion; callers must advance on observed presentation generation/known state, not a scripting API return convention.
A complete s3270 peer-script action response is the preferred differential evidence unit: data lines, 12-field status, and final ok/error stay bound together.
Reference keyboard U maps to UNLOCKED; L and operator-error E map to LOCKED for TerminalSnapshot comparison, while the raw s3270 code remains retained in reference status.
Each ReadBuffer(Ascii) data line must consume exactly the declared column count: SF/data/GE each consume one display position and SA consumes none; malformed row geometry fails closed.
s3270 field-level extended attributes 41/42/43/45 are compared explicitly, while SA character attributes are compared through a canonical detached digest that contains no display bytes.
Downstream MVS reference tooling must supply credentials at runtime; Terminal Machine continuity does not authorize packaged/default TSO passwords.
Candidate16 S3270Reference evidence is detached corroboration and cannot become Terminal Machine, MVS Alchemy or Hercules authority.
missing_work: Run candidate16 under exact ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 and execute the s3270 reference regression, including row-geometry and extended-attribute divergence cases.
Only after that passes, differentially qualify candidate16 against stable ED209Z states and repeat independently on ED209ZZ.
Capture a live Terminal Machine ISPF snapshot and compare it with the retained TK5 Figure 17 reference without promoting documentation evidence to live authority.
Adopt Socket Provider only when its concrete TCP connection exposes a qualified non-blocking readiness contract; do not unwrap raw provider internals to force the migration.
Add optional TN3270E BIND/RESPONSES/SYSREQ semantics only when negotiated and fully implemented; never claim optional functions speculatively.
